scope: Read-only artifact gate for six staged projection views against the adopted 1,128-source Current frontier. This does not publish an official projection or establish runtime conformance.

checks.name: pins_and_moved_source_authorities
checks.evidence: All six staged and six predecessor SHA-256 pins match. All 1,128 adopted-frontier destination paths exist under the moved authorities and match their frontier SHA-256 values.

checks.name: projection_headers_and_source_vectors
checks.evidence: Every staged header is Projection/Form Map and has no version. CA-PROJ-014/015/016/019 each retain the exact 1,128-item manifest source vector; CA-PROJ-017/018 retain source-vector subsets of that same frontier. The manifest vector and frontier have the same 1,128 unique source identities (their ordering differs only after lexicographic IDs such as CA-R-117 and CA-R-1174).

checks.name: containment_and_tree_views
checks.evidence: CA-PROJ-014 contains direct Aspects <+ Product facts and nested Aspects containment chains. CA-PROJ-018's Primary entities tree has no native // instance selector, retaining node-only MODEL-tree semantics.

checks.name: formal_contract_view
checks.evidence: CA-PROJ-019 has 41 relation sections, each with Semantics and Direct or Derived metadata; it retains 233 fenced raw Claim blocks. Manifest coverage has zero gaps, duplicate declarations, missing relation semantics, instance-kind gaps, and inheritance diagnostics.

checks.name: unsupported_cfel_boundary
checks.evidence: The view explicitly retains 195 unresolved/unsupported CFEL records. This is source-faithful extraction evidence, not runtime CFEL execution or full evaluator conformance.

not_checked: Official projection publication or predecessor archive/retirement
Runtime CFEL execution, full evaluator conformance, deployment, or release
A broad repository audit beyond the staged artifacts and adopted frontier
